# Vendored: PyPeT (CT and MR Perfusion Tool)

Source: <https://github.com/Marijn311/CT-and-MR-Perfusion-Tool>.
License: MIT with the Commons Clause License Condition v1.0 (see `LICENSE` in this directory).

A subset of the modules for perfusion-map generation is included. The modules were adapted
to use relative imports inside the `medtabx` package and to take their configuration at run time.
